testRunner_comment: Same Phase 02 switch as packages/db and packages/api: the vitest plugin's per-mutant runs complete zero tests under vitest 5.0.1; the command runner relies on the vitest exit code instead.
concurrency_comment: Serial is mandatory here, not a performance choice (same finding as packages/db). With the Stryker command runner under vitest 5.0.1, parallel workers share one sandbox and cross-contaminate runs, and a mutant whose run hangs is scored as killed. Measured on this host with the default parallelism: 3 killed, 0 survived, 117 timed out, reported as a false 100.00%. Serial is the only configuration that reproduces the committed report (112 killed, 13 survived, 0 timed out = 89.60%).
